faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers. If you need more help, feel free to contact us.

items.a1: Optimark is an all-in-one AI-powered digital marketing platform that helps businesses schedule social media content, optimize search engine visibility (SEO), and auto-create high-quality copy tailored to their brand voice.
items.q2: Do I need a credit card to try Optimark?
items.a2: No, you do not need a credit card to start our Free tier. You get free token credits every month to try out the AI Content Maker and Content Planner.
items.q3: How does the token system work?
items.a3: Each feature (like generating a caption or doing an SEO keyword audit) consumes a specific number of tokens. Your monthly tier gives you a fresh set of tokens. If you run out, you can top-up at any time.
items.q4: Which social media platforms are supported?
items.a4: Currently, you can connect and schedule posts to Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. We are constantly adding support for more platforms like Threads, X, and LinkedIn.
items.q5: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
items.a5: Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription plan directly from your billing settings at any time with no hidden fees.

support.title: Still have questions?
